mew-swift.name: Swift
mew-swift.description: Bond skill: never-missing stars up to 3 hexes away, even around others (Power 55).

mew-zen-headbutt.name: Zen Headbutt
mew-zen-headbutt.description: Bond skill: a headbutt charged with willpower (Power 80, Attack).

mew-baton-pass.name: Baton Pass
mew-baton-pass.description: Bond skill: hands its momentum to an ally up to 3 hexes away: Hasted and Focused 1 turn.

mew-bubble-shield.name: Bubble Shield
mew-bubble-shield.description: Floats in a psychic bubble: takes 20% less damage while at full HP.

mew-psychic-heritage.name: Psychic Heritage
mew-psychic-heritage.description: Its Psychic moves deal 15% more damage.

mew-soft-boiled.name: Soft-Boiled
mew-soft-boiled.description: New skill: shares a soft-boiled egg: heals itself or an ally within 2 hexes by 30 HP.

mew-psywave.name: Psywave
mew-psywave.description: New skill: an odd psychic wave at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 50).

mew-curious-mind.name: Curious Mind
mew-curious-mind.description: Deals 15% more damage to foes carrying any status.

mew-dazzling-gleam.name: Dazzling Gleam
mew-dazzling-gleam.description: New skill: a flash of light over a 1-hex area up to 1 hex away (Power 60).

mew-dizzy-punch.name: Dizzy Punch
mew-dizzy-punch.description: New skill: a dizzying punch (Power 65), Confusing the foe for 2 turns.

mew-adaptive-genes.name: Adaptive Genes
mew-adaptive-genes.description: Sheds statuses foes put on it at the start of its turn.

mew-mischief.name: Mischief
mew-mischief.description: Its free strikes on foes breaking away deal 25% more damage.

mew-nasty-plot.name: Nasty Plot
mew-nasty-plot.description: New skill: thinks up something wicked: Focused for 2 turns.

mew-iron-tail.name: Iron Tail
mew-iron-tail.description: New skill: whips its tail hard as iron (Power 85), leaving the foe Exposed 1 turn.

mew-weightless.name: Weightless
mew-weightless.description: Floats above the fray: its ranged moves fire over Pokémon in the way.

mew-elusive.name: Elusive
mew-elusive.description: Slips away from engaged foes without drawing free strikes.

mew-psyshock.name: Psyshock
mew-psyshock.description: New skill: a psychic wave at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 65).

mew-barrier.name: Barrier
mew-barrier.description: New skill: a psychic barrier makes it and allies within 1 hex Fortified for 2 turns.

mew-playful.name: Playful
mew-playful.description: Each combo it lands gives the team 1 Bond.

mew-ancestor-of-all.name: Ancestor of All
mew-ancestor-of-all.description: Capstone. Holds every move's potential: a knockout resets its skill cooldowns and refreshes its basic attack.

mew-mythical.name: Mythical
mew-mythical.description: Capstone. Its Bond skills cost 1 less; cannot fall Asleep, be Frozen or Paralyzed.

mew-metronome.name: Metronome
mew-metronome.description: Each hit in a row on the same foe deals 10% more damage, up to 3 stacks.

mew-copycat.name: Copycat
mew-copycat.description: Deals 20% more damage to foes carrying a status an ally applied.
